{{nihongo|'''Horowasan Haushiwake Shrine'''|保呂羽山波宇志別神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} on the slope of {{ill|Mount Horowa|Q11385697|qid=Q11385697}} in Yasawagi, Ōmori-machi, {{ill|Yokote, Akita|ar|يوكوته (أكيتا)|azb|یوکوته، آکیتا|ce|Йокоте|ceb|Yokote-shi|cs|Jokote (Akita)|de|Yokote|eo|Jokote|es|Yokote (Akita)|et|Yokote|fa|یوکوته، آکیتا|fi|Yokote|fr|Yokote|gl|Yokote|id|Yokote, Akita|it|Yokote|ja|横手市|kk|Йокоте қаласы|ko|요코테시|mg|Yokote|mzn|یوکوته، آکیتا|nl|Yokote|pl|Yokote|pt|Yokote|ro|Yokote|ru|Йокоте|sh|Jokote|sr|Јокоте|sv|Yokote|tg|Ёкоте|th|โยโกเตะ|tl|Yokote, Akita|tr|Yokote|tt|Йокоте|uk|Йокоте|ur|یوکوتے، اکیتا|uz|Yokote (Akita)|vi|Yokote, Akita|war|Yokote, Akita|zh|橫手市|zh_classical|橫手市|zh_min_nan|Yokote-chhī|zh_yue|橫手|qid=Q496479}}, {{ill|Akita Prefecture|Q81863|qid=Q81863}}. It is identified with the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=shikinaisha small shrine}} "Haushiwake Shrine" of Hiraka District, {{ill|Dewa Province|be|Дэва (правінцыя)|bpy|দেৱা|cs|Provincie Dewa|de|Provinz Dewa|es|Provincia de Dewa|fa|ولایت دوا|fr|Province de Dewa|gl|Provincia de Dewa|hi|देवा|id|Provinsi Dewa|it|Dewa (provincia)|ja|出羽国|ko|데와국|lt|Devos žemė|ms|Wilayah Dewa|new|देवा|nl|Dewa (provincie)|nn|Dewa-provinsen|pt|Província de Dewa|ru|Дэва (провинция)|simple|Dewa Province|sk|Dewa (provincia)|sr|Провинција Дева|tr|Dewa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Дева|zh|出羽國|zh_min_nan|Dewa-kok|zh_yue|出羽國|qid=Q876032}}, and its former rank was prefectural shrine. {{nihongo|'''Horowasan Haushiwake Shrine'''|保呂羽山波宇志別神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Dewa Province]].

== Origin ==
According to shrine tradition, in {{ill|AD 757|ab|757|af|757|am|757 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|757|ar|757|ast|757|avk|757|az|757|azb|۷۵۷ (میلادی)|bar|757|be|757|be_x_old|757|bg|757|bn|৭৫৭|bpy|মারি ৭৫৭|br|757|bs|757.|ca|757|cdo|757 nièng|ceb|757|ckb|٧٥٧|crh|757|cs|757|cv|757|cy|757|da|757|de|757|el|757|eml|757|eo|757|es|757|et|757|eu|757|fa|۷۵۷ (میلادی)|fi|757|fo|757|fr|757|frr|757|fy|757|ga|757|gan|757年|gd|757|gl|757|he|757|hi|757|hr|757.|ht|757 (almanak jilyen)|hu|757|hy|757|id|757|io|757|is|757|it|757|ja|757年|jv|757|ka|757|kk|757 жыл|ko|757년|la|757|lb|757|lij|757|lmo|757|lt|757 m.|map_bms|757|mdf|757|mg|757|mhr|757|mk|757|mr|इ.स. ७५७|mrj|757 и|ms|757|mzn|۷۵۷|nah|757|nap|757|nds|757|new|सन् ७५७|nl|757|nn|757|no|757|nrm|757|nso|757|oc|757|or|୭୫୭|os|757-æм аз|pl|757|pnb|757|pt|757|qu|757|ro|757|ru|757 год|rue|757|sa|७५७|scn|757|sd|757ع|sh|757.|si|757|sk|757|sl|757|smn|757|sq|757|sr|757|su|757|sv|757|sw|757|tg|Соли 757|th|พ.ศ. 1300|tk|757|tl|757|tly|757|tr|757|tt|757 ел|uk|757|ur|757ء|uz|757|vec|757|vi|757|war|757|wuu|757年|xmf|757|zh|757年|zh_min_nan|757 nî|zh_yue|757年|qid=Q31135}} ({{ill|Tenpyō-hōji|de|Tempyō-Hōji|es|Tenpyō-hōji|fa|تنپیو-هوجی|fr|Ère Tenpyō-hōji|ia|Tenpyo-hoji|id|Tempyō-hōji|ja|天平宝字|ko|덴표호지|ru|Тэмпё-ходзи|simple|Tenpyō-hōji|sr|Тенпјо хоџи|tr|Tenpyō-hōji|uk|Темпьо-Ходзі (ненґо)|zh|天平宝字|zh_yue|天平寶字|qid=Q1346307}} 1), Ōtomo Yoshichika invited {{ill|Zaō Gongen|Q10514059|qid=Q10514059}} of {{ill|Mount Kinpusen|Q10563986|qid=Q10563986}} in Yoshino, {{ill|Yamato Province|Q907495|qid=Q907495}}, and founded the shrine at the current site. Of the three shikinaisha in Akita Prefecture, this is the only one continuously surviving without interruption. In the medieval period it drew reverence as a sacred site of Shugendō.

According to records held by the Ōtomo family, since foundation the Ōtomo family, said to descend from the {{ill|Ōtomo clan (ancient)|Q17227938|qid=Q17227938}}, served as {{ill|Bettō|es|Bettō|fa|بتتو|fr|Bettō|it|Bettō|ja|別当|pt|Bettō|qid=Q2900274}}. In the early Edo period, because the Ōtomo head was a child, bettō were temporarily provided from both the Ōtomo and Moriya families. In {{ill|1853|Q7666|qid=Q7666}} ({{ill|Kaei|Q1146125|qid=Q1146125}} 6), a fire from the Moriya family residence caused deaths of lodging pilgrims and loss of domain-issued documents; Moriya Sagenji was punished by exile. The Moriya family line continued via adopted heir Moriya Mikinoshin with shrine duties, but after he was summoned in Meiji 2 (March 27) from priestly office to near-retainer service, the Moriya family moved to Kubota castle town. Since then to the present, the Ōtomo family has served as {{ill|Gūji|Q11453500|qid=Q11453500}}. (Separate lineage traditions are also preserved in the now-defunct-as-priestly Moriya family.)

In the early modern period, as one of the three major shrines of the Akita domain designated by the {{ill|Satake clan|Q2975363|qid=Q2975363}}, it received strong reverence; the bettō of Haushiwake Shrine also served as head of domain shrine houses. National studies flourished there, with Ōtomo Chikahisa studying under {{ill|Motoori Norinaga|ar|موتوري نوريناغا|bg|Мотоори Норинага|de|Motoori Norinaga|es|Motoori Norinaga|fa|موتوئوری نوریناگا|fi|Motoori Norinaga|fr|Motoori Norinaga|gl|Motoori Norinaga|hu|Motoori Norinaga|it|Motoori Norinaga|ja|本居宣長|ka|მოტოორი ნორინაგა|ko|모토오리 노리나가|lt|Norinaga Motoori|mt|Motoori Norinaga|pl|Norinaga Motoori|pt|Motoori Norinaga|ro|Motoori Norinaga|ru|Мотоори Норинага|simple|Motoori Norinaga|sl|Motoori Norinaga|th|โมโตริ โนรินางะ|uk|Мотоорі Норінаґа|zh|本居宣長|qid=Q384647}} and Ōtomo Naoe under {{ill|Motoori Ōhira|Q3325272|qid=Q3325272}}, influencing regional trends in the late Edo period.

A theory by {{ill|Naoyoshi Niino|Q11504231|qid=Q11504231}} suggests the original deity may have been {{ill|Otori-sama|Q10939697|qid=Q10939697}}, but this is not among current enshrined deities.
